title: Regularization by a functorial saturated log blowup tower
statement: Fix the monoidal resolution rule induced by the saturated smooth-functorial fan resolution of [lem-trf-functorial-fan-desingularization]. For every Noetherian separated fs log regular scheme $(X,M)$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], [pqf-def-locnoeth], this rule gives a finite tower of saturated log blowups with regular log regular source [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Its underlying scheme tower is a tower of normalized blowups, with finite normalization maps, and is projective in the projective-bundle sense [def-trf-projective-bundle-morphism]. It is an isomorphism on the locus where $X$ is already regular. The construction is compatible with automorphisms and, up to contraction of unit-center stages, with strict pullback between the indicated schemes: the strict-transform tower is the scheme pullback. The comparisons retain ordered center ideals and respect composition. All stages are Noetherian and normal. If $X$ is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme], so are the stages, and the composite is birational, meaning an isomorphism on dense open subschemes. The statement allows disconnected $X$ and does not assume excellence. Here a normalized blowup is an ordinary blowup followed by componentwise normalization in its function fields [def-nagata-global-blowup], [def-sc-normalization].

source.place: VIII Theorems 3.3.15 and 3.4.9, §§3.4.5--3.4.8, printed pp.107--112; finiteness of saturations explained again in 5.3.11, p.126.
